description: The chart illustrates five distinct bar graph patterns, each representing a different distribution type. The horizontal axis is labeled with the categories "Increasing", "Uniform", "Decreasing", "Spindle", and "Bottleneck", which are listed in a fixed order. The vertical axis is unlabeled but appears to represent a value or magnitude, with a scale that is not explicitly defined. Each category contains a group of three bars, colored in various shades of green, with the height of the bars varying according to the distribution type. The "Increasing" category has bars that increase in height from left to right, with approximate values ranging from small to large. The "Uniform" category has bars of equal height. The "Decreasing" category has bars that decrease in height from left to right, with the tallest bar on the left and the shortest in the middle. The "Spindle" category has bars with the tallest in the middle and shorter bars on either side. The "Bottleneck" category has bars with the shortest in the middle and taller bars on either side. The bars within each category are not labeled or annotated, and there is no visible sorting or emphasis within the groups.
